volseq_pathline_render — LIVE4D flow op

• 数据种类:volseq → rgb

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.volseq_pathline_render(volseq, n_seeds: 'int' = 200, yaw: 'float' = 35.0, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, size: 'int' = 256, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.03, win: 'int' = 3, pyr_levels: 'int' = 3, iters: 'int' = 5, reg: 'float' = 0.001, seed: 'int' = 0, trail_sigma: 'float' = 0.7, min_speed: 'float' = 0.1, min_intensity: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'np.ndarray'(要直接调用实现,import live4d; live4d.volseq_pathline_render(volseq, n_seeds: 'int' = 200, yaw: 'float' = 35.0, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, size: 'int' = 256, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.03, win: 'int' = 3, pyr_levels: 'int' = 3, iters: 'int' = 5, reg: 'float' = 0.001, seed: 'int' = 0, trail_sigma: 'float' = 0.7, min_speed: 'float' = 0.1, min_intensity: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'np.ndarray';从台账取用则 opslive4d.get("volseq_pathline_render"))

用法

让粒子随流动而绘出的轨迹立体 (size, size, 3)(rgb)——用一张静止图像展示运动。

用相邻帧之间的位移场(vol_flow_3d),把从运动中(速度 >= min_speed)且明亮(不低于首帧值域的 min_intensity = 有结构)的地方撒下的 n_seeds 个粒子按位移场的映射平流, 把轨迹以时刻的颜色(蓝 = 开始 → 红 = 结束)画进立方体,再用 vol_render_transfer 从任意视点合成。static_alpha > 0 时以浅灰叠上首帧的亮度(流经何处的线索)。trail_sigma 是轨迹的粗细(voxel)。没有纹理的地方流无法确定(孔径问题),所以种子只限于明亮处 —— 只按速度选的话,种子也会落到漆黑的角落,立方体被轨迹填满(实测)。
